instruction: Please help disable the 'Show foreground & background color' option in the toolbox.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the foreground & background color display in the toolbox via Edit > Preferences > Toolbox. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for (toolbox-color-area no) using the existing check_config_status metric. Similar difficulty to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks that 'toolbox-color-area' is set to 'no' in GIMP config file
Getter logic is correct: extracts gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc which contains the toolbox preference settings
Metric logic is correct: check_config_status correctly parses GIMP config format '(key value)' and matches the expected key-value pair
Expected value is semantically correct: '(toolbox-color-area no)' is the correct GIMP config syntax to disable foreground/background color display
Postconfig is necessary and correct: closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure config changes are written to disk before evaluation
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the only requirement in the instruction
Correct rule parameter handling: metric function uses 'rule' parameter and directly accesses rule dict (not expected.rules)
Edge cases handled: if config file is missing or empty, getter returns None and metric returns 0.0
